sources.title: clip-vit-base-patch32: Text-to-Image model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Overview clip-vit-base-patch32 is a vision-language model developed by openai that learns joint embeddings of images and text through contrastive learning. The model uses a ViT-B/32 Transformer architecture as its image encoder paired with a masked self-attention Transformer as its text encoder, trained to maximize similarity between (image, text) pairs via contrastive loss.
